verdict.rationale: Google and one HN commenter claim Gemini CLI's 1M-token context lets it 'navigate and learn' large codebases effortlessly without manual file selection, but other developers report it is 'stupid at navigation in the codebase,' gets 'stuck in spaghetti code,' and even ignores its own GEMINI.md context file, indicating inconsistent real-world codebase comprehension.
